# Vineet Edupuganti, Cogent Security CEO on AI Vulnerability Management

Venture with Grace

Play

Vineet Edupuganti is Co-Founder & CEO of Cogent Security, deploying generative AI to supercharge vulnerability management and risk reduction for global brands, after scaling Abnormal Security from early PM through Head of Multi-Product Platform where he grew his 30-person division 4X, launched Knowledge Base/Security Posture Management, rolled out RBAC platform capabilities, and drove PLG initiatives as ARR crossed $100M with 15X headcount growth. Ex-ML engineer at Meta (generative AI for Facebook Assistant), Stanford researcher (GANs/VAEs accelerating MRI 10X, 100+ citations at top ML conferences), New Relic (time-series forecasting), and Menlo Ventures (AI incubation), Vineet fuses hardcore AI systems with enterprise security product leadership giving him deep insight into scaling AI product strategy, engineering, and go-to-market execution.Topics:

- AI operational excellence: building data labeling, ML pipelines, and PM systems
- How Abnormal Security rocketed to $100M ARR with smart platform pivots and product-led growth
- Lessons from growing teams 4X during 15X company hypergrowth while launching new products

### The Rise of the Autonomous Blue Team with Vineet Edupuganti

Sep 4, 2025

Sep 4, 2025

37 min

What if defenders had their own AI-powered task force, always on, always adapting, and finally one step ahead of attackers?

In this episode, Ron welcomes Vineet Edupuganti, Founder and CEO of Cogent Security, to discuss how AI agents are rewriting the rules of cybersecurity. Vineet shares why traditional vulnerability management is fundamentally broken, why exposure management matters more than ever, and how Cogent is building an “AI Task Force” to give defenders the edge. From his early days in machine learning to reshaping the future of cyber defense, Vineet breaks down the urgent need for automation, context-driven insights, and explainable AI in security.

# Rethinking Security at Scale: Cogent’s Mission to Outpace Attackers - Cogent Security

CyberBytes: The Podcast

Play

In this episode, we sit down with Vineet Edupuganti, CEO and Co-Founder of Cogent Security, an AI-powered vulnerability management company reshaping how enterprises defend against today’s rapidly evolving threats. Vineet shares his journey from machine learning engineer to leading product and engineering at Abnormal Security, and now building Cogent to tackle one of cybersecurity’s most persistent challenges: turning vulnerability data into real, actionable remediation.

Recorded live at Black Hat 2025 in Las Vegas, this conversation dives into the founding story of Cogent, the shortcomings of legacy tools, how AI is shifting the balance between attackers and defenders, and what it takes to assemble world-class talent from companies like DeepMind, Stripe, and Tesla. Vineet also opens up about the role of investors, customer trust, and why he believes vulnerability management needs a complete rethink.

Whether you’re a security leader, builder, or simply curious about the future of AI in cybersecurity, this episode offers a candid look at how Cogent plans to close the gap between vulnerabilities and fixed, and why the time is now.
